name: kathapp
description: Multilingual Catholic knowledge hub — monorepo scaffold

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kathapp/shared && npm run build -w @kathapp/api && npm run build -w @kathapp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kathapp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @kathapp/api && npm run typecheck -w @kathapp/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kathapp/shared && npm run test -w @kathapp/api && npm run test -w @kathapp/web
